limitations: Static parsing is not syscall, runtime branch or symlink attestation. Codex exec JSONL exposes only the command display and omits cwd; current production commands are explicitly unverified.

Unsupported wrapper grammar is refused even for a benign utility; supported env/nice/timeout forms retain position decoding.
